format:

    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.7.2/css/all.min.css">
listing:
  id: team-listing

    - team/*.yaml

  image-height: "220px"

  field-types:
    user_groups: badges
  sort: title
  grid-columns: 3
